info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Replace Streaming Subscriptions Downgrade-v3-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Downgrade API allows clients to manage subscription levels for streaming services. By facilitating the downgrade process, this API ensures users can easily adjust their subscription plans according to their current needs and usage patterns. Common consumers include service administrators and customer support teams who manage user accounts and subscription modifications. This endpoint enhances user experience by providing a seamless transition between different subscription tiers while maintaining access to necessary features.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to downgrade their current subscription plan to a lower tier. Ensure that the new plan meets any eligibility requirements before proceeding with the downgrade.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to downgrade a subscription. The client must provide the required information in the JSON format to successfully perform the downgrade operation.

204.description: Successfully processed the request with no content returned.
